notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no notes for 2 Chronicles 26 yet. My first attempt to search the approved sites failed: the tool said I had no searches left for this session, so I didn't get to read a single page. That was a set of six searches, covering Enduring Word on 2 Chronicles 26, Uzziah's leprosy and the incense offering, Got Questions on Uzziah, the Catholic Encyclopedia entry on "Ozias", sermons on Uzziah's pride, and Zechariah's teaching of the king.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say, give a URL for every point and leave out anything I couldn't find. I haven't read any pages, so I've left everything out. I haven't filled the gaps from my own knowledge, because then I couldn't give you sources.

**What I'll do when the tool works again** (in a new message or session):
1. **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word on 2 Chronicles 26, and the Bible Hub and StudyLight commentaries (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Matthew Henry). I'll also check Precept Austin for any Uzziah material.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Spurgeon, Desiring God and GTY (Baptist), Wesley's Notes on wesley.nnu.edu (Methodist), Ligonier and The Gospel Coalition (Reformed), and LCMS and 1517 (Lutheran). The verses where differences seem most likely are v. 5 (seeking God and success) and vv. 16–21 (Uzziah offering incense as king, and the priesthood).
3. **Other views:**
   - **Modern scholarship:** the NET Bible notes, for example on the "devices" in v. 15, Zechariah in v. 5 and the burial in v. 23, and Bible Odyssey.
   - **Catholic and Orthodox:** the Catholic Encyclopedia entry "Ozias" on New Advent, Catholic Answers, and OCA material.
   - **Popular modern teaching:** any prosperity-teaching readings of v. 5 ("as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success"), as the sites describe them.

If you can, please send the request again and I'll start with these sources.
